articles.summary: Odigos VM Agent is a powerful tool that brings automatic, code-free distributed tracing to Linux virtual machines, simplifying observability for systemd-managed services across multiple programming languages.
articles.title: Odigos VM Agent: Simplified Distributed Tracing for Virtual Machines

articles.summary: Discover how Odigos revolutionizes database monitoring with eBPF technology. Gain real-time insights into MySQL and PostgreSQL performance by connecting client and server activities in a single trace. Optimize queries, troubleshoot issues, and enhance database efficiency with minimal overhead. Experience the future of observability with Odigos`s innovative eBPF-powered monitoring solution.
articles.title: Revolutionizing Database Internals Monitoring with eBPF and Real-Time Insights

articles.summary: This guide walks through migrating from proprietary observability tools to OpenTelemetry, covering each stage of the transition and best practices. Learn how Odigos simplifies this process with automated instrumentation and centralized configuration, helping IT leaders, developers, and operations teams achieve flexible and efficient observability.
articles.title: Migrating from Proprietary Tools to OpenTelemetry with Odigos
